title: RoboTok: An Internet-Scale Data Engine for Human Demonstration Video Retrieval and Dexterous Manipulation Learning
authors: *Howard H. Qian*, Yiting Chen, Yunfei Xie, Kejia Ren, Podshara Chanrungmaneekul, Gaotian Wang, Bowen Wen, Chen Wei, Kaiyu Hang
description: RoboTok is an internet-scale data engine for robot manipulation learning. It organizes internet human demonstration videos into a torso-relative 3D hand trajectory embedding space and retrieves clips with similar hand motions for a given query demonstration.
